71214cba45d7caa6.en: Work on site Т-4 is authorized for the current stage. The direct pedestrian route is closed within the approved boundaries, with a detour provided. The permit and plan are valid on the observation date, which is the event date. These details are synthetic. An authorized technical specialist inspected Т-4 itself on the event date. The detour complies with the attached plan and accessibility requirements and does not require entering a traffic lane. The complaint identifies no other actual defect.
71214cba45d7caa6.zh: Т-4地段当前阶段的施工已获许可。直行通道在批准的边界内封闭，并设置了绕行路线。许可和方案在观察日，即事件当日有效。信息均为虚构。有权技术人员于事件当日检查的正是Т-4。绕行路线符合所附方案及无障碍要求，无需进入行车道。投诉未指出其他实际缺陷。

0add2a89c584599e.en: The notice board displays the original decision for Т-9 without amendments. The photograph was taken on the event date. According to that document, the initial period has expired. The authenticity of the training extract is established in the case conditions. Before the original period expired, an extension was approved for Т-9 specifically, covering the current stage. The extension is valid on the photograph date. Inspection confirmed that the current boundaries and pedestrian route comply.
0add2a89c584599e.zh: 公示牌展示的是Т-9的原始决定，未附补充文件。照片拍摄于事件当日。依该文件，原定期限已届满。教学摘录的真实性已在案情中确认。原定期限届满前，已针对Т-9作出覆盖当前阶段的延期决定。照片拍摄时延期有效。检查确认现有边界及通行路线符合规定。

0cbfa9253882bbfb.en: The reported interval is after 23:00 before the specified date on the event date; the side of the crossing is identified. A report of intermittent signal failure is not a technical finding about its cause. The inspection record confirms normal operation at 12:00 the following day. Night-time operation was not checked. The competent service can compare the controller logs with the interval stated on the case card.
0cbfa9253882bbfb.zh: 材料注明事件日期所涉及的日期之前23:00以后的时段，以及过街地点的具体一侧。关于信号间歇消失的陈述，并非认定原因的技术结论。检查记录确认次日12:00运行正常，未检查夜间模式。有权部门可以将控制器日志与案情卡所载时段进行核对。

fcc99d133b781e5b.en: A specific signal-phase plan is approved for П-7. Inspection confirmed that it is being followed. The materials do not establish that this plan is optimal for every pedestrian group. A proposal seeks to extend one phase by ten seconds. There is no calculation of its effect on the other phases. The authorized traffic management unit evaluates the proposal; the reception office prepares the materials and response.
fcc99d133b781e5b.zh: П-7已批准采用特定的信号相位方案。检查确认实际执行符合方案。材料并未认定该方案对所有行人群体均为最优。有人建议将一个相位延长十秒，但缺少对其他相位影响的计算。有权交通组织部门评估建议，接待处负责准备材料及答复。

a1ad9a3f59c451b2.en: Power supply and switching work correctly. The inspection record concerns crossing П-3. It contains no assessment of signal visibility from the library side. A specialist confirmed that branches obstruct the view from that side. The training card identifies two competent services: traffic-device maintenance and vegetation care. Independent tree cutting is not provided for.
a1ad9a3f59c451b2.zh: 供电与信号切换均正常。检查记录对应П-3过街点，但未评估从图书馆一侧能否看清信号。专业人员确认，该侧视线被树枝遮挡。教学案情卡列明两类有权处理人员：交通设施维护人员及绿化养护人员。不安排自行砍伐。

94f26b2ce1475db6.en: After strong wind, a large branch on tree Д-31 is damaged above a pedestrian route in use. The duty officer's card confirms that the report is current. Responsible specialists, not the student, determine the danger-zone boundary and measures. The site duty officer and the specialist vegetation inspection service are identified. Safe restrictions on access and a professional assessment are arranged. The game simulates messages; it does not send them to real services.
94f26b2ce1475db6.zh: 大风后，Д-31号树位于正在使用的通道上方的一根大树枝受损。值班记录确认信息仍有效。危险区域边界及措施由负责的专业人员确定，而非由学生决定。已明确辖区值班人员及绿化专业检查部门。应安排安全限制接近和专业评估。游戏仅模拟消息，不向真实部门发送。

3eceb1ab0b2ac189.en: The appeal challenges the removal of trees Д-14 and Д-15. Their location and identifiers are confirmed by the accepted document set, not inferred from the species. The authorized department confirmed a valid basis for removing Д-14 and Д-15; the expert conclusion and inspection record concern those trees. The case conditions establish no deviations in this work. The materials are synthetic, not a report about a real site.
3eceb1ab0b2ac189.zh: 来函质疑移除Д-14及Д-15两棵树。其位置和编号由已接收材料确认，并非根据树种外观推定。有权部门已确认移除Д-14及Д-15具有有效依据，专业结论及记录对应的正是这两棵树。案情未认定此次作业存在偏差。材料均属虚构，并非关于真实地点的报告。

c676894433a40437.en: The valid document for Д-22 permits sanitary pruning of the specified branches. Removing the trunk is outside its scope. The issuing procedure is specified by this training set, not presented as universal throughout Russia. An authorized specialist recorded the removal of the Д-22 trunk. The identifier and site match. The supplied set contains no information about an additional authorization; its existence must be checked.
c676894433a40437.zh: Д-22的有效文件允许对指定树枝进行卫生性修剪，移除树干不在文件许可范围内。签发程序由本教学材料设定，不作为全俄罗斯通用规则。有权专业人员记录了Д-22树干被移除的情况，编号及地点一致。现有材料未包含其他授权依据的信息，需核查其是否存在。

b55eee6e41b8688c.en: Training materials; the external link leads to the legal basis
b55eee6e41b8688c.zh: 教学材料；外部链接指向法律依据

0b68d125b1073256.en: The first passage is authored material from a fictional case, not a published act of a real organization. The second briefly summarizes a legal rule. Linking to the source of that rule does not substantiate the fictional events.
0b68d125b1073256.zh: 第一段是虚构案例的作者编写材料，并非真实组织发布的文件。第二段是对法律规范的简要概述。提供该规范的来源链接，并不能证明虚构事件真实发生。

e1eb63c32ad33490.en:
List of agreed channels: Only email is selected in the separate verified consent. SMS is explicitly excluded, and the telephone advertising channel box is not selected. The number was provided for a specific service interaction.

Disputed advertising messages: The log records an advertising SMS to the applicant's number. No email was sent at that time; the text promotes new products. The checked documents contain no other consent to SMS.
e1eb63c32ad33490.zh:
已同意渠道清单：在单独核实的同意书中，仅选择了电子邮件。短信被明确排除，电话广告渠道选项未被勾选。电话号码是为特定服务联系而提供的。

有争议的广告发送记录：日志记录了向申请人号码发送的广告短信。当时没有发送电子邮件；短信内容推广新商品。已核查文件中不存在其他短信同意。

a75d95feedbbb24d.en:
Text of the disputed message: The message is addressed to the buyer of order Z-18: “Your paid order is ready for collection. The collection point and opening hours are stated in the order.” There are no discounts, offers of new products, recommendations or advertising links. The case contains the complete text.

Order Z-18 record: The applicant placed the order personally and provided the telephone number for communication about fulfilment. The data controller and sender have been identified; the legality of other data processing is outside the conclusion about this single message.
a75d95feedbbb24d.zh:
争议消息全文：消息发送给 Z-18 订单买家：“您已付款的订单可以领取。取货点及营业时间见订单。”其中没有折扣、新商品推销、推荐或广告链接。案卷提供了完整内容。

Z-18 订单记录：订单由申请人本人提交，电话号码用于订单履行联系。数据处理者和发送方已查明；其他数据处理是否合法，不属于对这一条消息所作结论的范围。

39bcf77fdbec2264.en:
Consent and recipient: A separate valid consent specifies advertising SMS from this organisation to the applicant's number. For messages before the request, the scenario confirms both the existence and scope of prior consent.

Request and sending log: The advertising distributor received the demand to stop SMS at 10:15. The next disputed advertising message was sent at 14:20 the same day. Delayed delivery is ruled out: the comparison concerns the actual sending time. The channel used for the request and its recipient are confirmed.
39bcf77fdbec2264.zh:
同意与接收人：一份单独且有效的同意书规定，该组织可向申请人的号码发送广告短信。对于请求之前的消息，题设已确认事先同意的存在及范围。

请求与发送日志：广告传播者于 10:15 收到停止短信的请求。下一条争议广告消息于同日 14:20 发出。已排除延迟送达：此处比较的正是发送时间。请求提交渠道及接收方均已确认。

e3143f0720fc786c.en:
Information about the intermediary: The “Training Ticket” website is an independent seller. Under the contract provided, it is not authorised to receive claims on behalf of the carrier. Its receipt of the letter on {{agent}} did not constitute receipt by the carrier. Its own forwarding obligations are considered separately.

Carrier’s notice: The carrier received a properly submitted claim on {{carrier}}. This is the confirmed event that starts its consideration period. The intermediary website’s reply only concerns registration with the intermediary itself, not acceptance or rejection of the claim by the carrier.
e3143f0720fc786c.zh:
中介信息：“教学机票”网站是独立销售方。依据所提供的合同，该网站无权代表承运人接收索赔。网站于{{agent}}收到信函，并不构成承运人收件。网站自身的转交义务另行审查。

承运人通知：承运人于{{carrier}}收到合规索赔。这是其审理期限经确认的起算事件。中介网站的回复仅涉及中介自身的登记，并不代表承运人同意或驳回索赔。

f97d1e6d63ea202e.en:
Ticket and cancellation notice: A direct domestic flight and a wholly unused ticket. Cancellation by the carrier is confirmed. The scenario excludes other journey segments, medical grounds and the special regime in Article 107.2 of the Air Code.

Passenger's application and offer: The passenger declared involuntary withdrawal specifically because of cancellation. No agreement to replace a refund with a voucher was concluded. The carrier's receipt of the proper claim on {{carrier}} is confirmed. Payment details are available to the authorised recipient and are not published in the game.
f97d1e6d63ea202e.zh:
机票与取消通知：直达国内航班，机票完全未使用。承运人取消航班已获确认。题设排除了其他运输区段、医疗原因以及《航空法典》第 107.2 条的特别制度。

乘客申请与提议：乘客明确因取消航班而提出非自愿退乘。未达成以代金券替代退款的协议。已确认承运人于 {{carrier}} 收到合规索赔。付款信息可由授权接收方获取，不在游戏中公开。

0221ffd6fccacddf.en:
Ticket and boarding log: A direct domestic flight operated by a fictional carrier. The ticket gives departure as 08:00. Boarding had not begun by 15:00; all seven hours of waiting were during daytime. Confirmed adverse weather caused the delay. The scenario excludes special regimes restricting transport.

Passenger-service log: Water was provided at 10:30. No hot meals or drinks had been arranged by 15:00; there is no record of vouchers or alternative provision. A mother-and-child room, hotel accommodation and repeat intervals are outside this task.
0221ffd6fccacddf.zh:
机票与登机日志：虚构承运人运营的直达国内航班。机票注明 08:00 起飞。到 15:00 仍未开始登机，七小时等待全部发生在白天。延误原因为已确认的恶劣天气。题设不适用限制运输的特别制度。

旅客服务日志：10:30 提供了水。截至 15:00 尚未安排热餐和饮品，也无餐券或替代提供方式的记录。母婴室、酒店及重复服务间隔不属于本题范围。

f458e9767027641f.en:
Urgent incident report card: The dispatcher registered the report under training reference G-16. The record lists house 7, block 2. Acceptance of the call is confirmed, but arrival at the correct block is not.

Applicant's clarification: The current report concerns house 7, block 3. The applicant is now outside the danger zone and reports a continuing sign of danger; the applicant is not being asked to inspect the site personally. The discrepancy in the block number has been confirmed by a further clarification.
f458e9767027641f.zh:
紧急情况报告卡：调度员已按教学编号 G-16 登记报告。记录中的地址是 7 号、2 栋。已经确认接警，但尚未确认人员到达正确楼栋。

申请人的补充说明：当前报告涉及 7 号、3 栋。申请人目前在危险区域外，报告危险迹象仍然存在；不得要求其自行检查现场。再次询问后，已确认楼栋编号存在差异。

09d61c9669cabfdd.en:
Record for call G-25: Authorised specialists inspected the exact site identified in call G-25, carried out the measures described in the record and documented the result at the time of inspection. The record is not an indefinite guarantee that the site is safe.

Applicant's confirmation: The applicant confirms that no current smell, hissing or other new signs of danger are being reported. The request concerns what actions were carried out and obtaining a clear reply about the earlier call.
09d61c9669cabfdd.zh:
G-25 报案处理记录：有权专业人员检查了 G-25 报案所指的具体现场，实施了记录中所述措施，并记录了检查时的结果。该记录并非对现场安全作出的无限期保证。

申请人的确认：申请人确认：目前没有报告异味、嘶嘶声或其他新的危险迹象。其请求是了解已经采取的措施，并就此前报案获得清晰答复。

9c17ecc7bd57ebaf.en:
Scheduled-work notice: The notice identifies site G-31 and a scheduled shutdown for part of the day. It confirms the plan, but contains no assessment of the specific current report of a smell and does not state that every smell is harmless.

Current report from outside the site: The visitor reports a smell occurring now, from a safe place outside the suspected danger zone. She has not carried out her own inspection. According to the reception office, there is not yet confirmation that this specific report has been relayed to the dispatcher.
9c17ecc7bd57ebaf.zh:
计划作业公告：公告列明 G-31 设施以及当天部分时段的计划停供。公告证明的是计划，没有评估当前关于异味的具体报告，也没有声称任何异味都没有危险。

从现场外发来的当前报告：来访者在疑似危险区域外的安全地点，报告此刻存在异味。她没有自行检查。根据接待处掌握的信息，尚未确认已将这份具体报告转交调度员。

03745c5ae8161cbc.en:
Permit and approved project extract: For asset H-21, a valid conservation document package is confirmed: a permit, the corresponding project documentation and the required supervision. The project allows temporary removal of elements E-3 and E-4 for restoration, with recording, storage and reinstatement. Under the case conditions, structural characteristics are not affected and the other necessary conditions are met.

Element transfer log: Elements E-3 and E-4 were removed from asset H-21; their markings, storage location and responsible restorer are recorded. The log contains no disposal or destruction entry; the materials do not confirm work beyond the approved scope.
03745c5ae8161cbc.zh:
许可及已批准的项目文件摘录：已确认H-21具备有效的保护工程文件包，包括许可、相应的项目文件及规定的监督措施。项目允许临时拆卸E-3和E-4构件进行修复，并要求登记、保存及复位。按照案件条件，结构特性不受影响，其他必要条件也已满足。

构件移交日志：已从H-21拆下E-3和E-4构件，记录了标记、存放地点及负责修复的人员。日志中没有报废或销毁记录，材料也未证实超出批准范围施工。

cfef8c227e8977b6.en:
Authority’s reply on protected status: The authority confirms that building H-32 is included in the current list of identified cultural heritage assets. Its identifier, address and boundaries match the work site. Registration has not yet been completed.

Information on the ongoing works: The work at H-32 specifically concerns facade conservation. The contractor supplies only the owner’s consent and cites the absence of a register entry. A permit package for the works is not confirmed in the materials.
cfef8c227e8977b6.zh:
机关关于保护状态的答复：机关确认建筑H-32已列入现行已识别文化遗产对象名录。编号、地址及边界均与施工地点一致，但正式入册尚未完成。

正在进行的工程情况：H-32进行的正是立面保护工程。承包方只提供所有者同意，并以登记册中没有条目为由。现有材料未能确认工程许可文件包。

d72a7cafff7bad0f.en:
Licence extract: The organization Training Restoration holds a valid licence for the activity specified in the document. The extract concerns the organization; it does not identify asset H-44, the specific works on it or the project.

Document-package check for H-44: The authorized unit confirms H-44’s protected status and that conservation works are taking place. At this stage, the checked package contains the licence and the owner’s letter, but no permit for the specific works. The case does not establish a separate applicable simplified procedure.
d72a7cafff7bad0f.zh:
资质许可摘录：“教学修复”单位持有针对文件所列活动的有效资质许可。该摘录针对的是单位，没有列明H-44对象、其上的具体工程或项目文件。

H-44文件包核查：有权限的部门确认H-44受保护，且正在进行保护工程。目前核查的文件包中只有资质许可和所有者函件，缺少具体工程许可。案件条件未表明存在另行适用的简化程序。

4477adc134868589.en:
Lighting switch-off report S-23: Night lighting at S-23 is switched off. The report concerns lighting; it did not assess noise or vibration.

Applicant's clarification: The applicant confirms that the disturbing light is absent after the stated measure. At the same time, she first reports a hum in the room, whose source she suspects is on the façade. There are no measurements or conclusions on its cause.
4477adc134868589.zh:
S-23灯光关闭记录：S-23的夜间灯光已关闭。记录涉及照明，未评估噪声和振动。

申请人的补充说明：申请人确认采取所述措施后，扰人的灯光已消失。同时，她首次反映房间内有嗡鸣，猜测声源位于外墙。没有测量数据或嗡鸣原因结论。

d2118d6ced91bec0.en:
Inspection report L-08: L-08 was inspected at 11:30 with lighting off. The report describes only that condition; there are no measurements or conclusions regarding nighttime operation.

Owner's letter about the schedule: The owner confirms automatic activation of L-08 from 22:00 to 06:00. It displays the name and opening hours without product offers. The conditions establish the authority's competence to arrange review of the lighting effect under the prescribed procedure.
d2118d6ced91bec0.zh:
L-08检查记录：L-08于11:30在灯光关闭时接受检查。记录仅描述该状态，没有夜间运行测量或相关结论。

业主关于运行时间的信件：业主确认L-08自动开启时间为22:00至06:00。内容是名称和营业时间，不含商品推销。案情确定该机关有权按规定程序组织审查灯光影响。

98ad0cb6f20f5e4a.en:
Recording of the screen's evening cycle: The recording dated {{observed}} identifies structure S-14. Between displays of the shop name, rotating product offers show discounts, prices and invitations to buy. The recording covers a full cycle. Nighttime brightness was not measured instrumentally.

Earlier structure record: Record S-14 describes the old static sign showing the name and opening hours. The owner calls the new screen a sign; the old record contains no content changes. Advertising and lighting review responsibilities in this training authority are assigned to different units.
98ad0cb6f20f5e4a.zh:
屏幕晚间播放周期录像：{{observed}}的录像标明设施S-14。在商店名称画面之间，轮播商品优惠，显示折扣、价格和购买邀请。录像涵盖完整周期。未用仪器测量夜间亮度。

此前设施记录：S-14记录描述旧的静态标牌，只显示名称和营业时间。业主将新屏幕称作标牌，旧记录未记载内容变化。本教学机关的广告与照明技术审查权限分属不同部门。

335e89746eee6958.en:
Placement record Р-18: The characteristics of beer advertising and its placement on a website page have been confirmed. The material is accessible online; it is not a photograph of an internal price list attached to an appeal.

Distributor’s explanation: The distributor points to the 18+ label and warning. These elements are indeed present; no other circumstances affecting the classification or channel have been provided.
335e89746eee6958.zh:
发布记录Р-18：已确认材料具有啤酒广告特征，并发布在网站页面上。该材料可通过互联网访问，并非诉求中附带的内部价目表照片。

发布方的说明：发布方指出存在18+标识和警示语。这些元素确实存在，但未提供会改变材料定性或传播渠道的其他情况。

e1f2ec35f3321dc6.zh: 仅适用于虚构案件 beer-online-agegate

987ca1deb4f5d491.en: An age label does not change the channel · materials and legal basis
987ca1deb4f5d491.zh: 年龄标识不会改变传播渠道 · 材料与依据

bbababa90a7bcc85.en: Longer does not mean unlawful · basis for the conclusion
bbababa90a7bcc85.zh: 路更长，不等于违法 · 结论依据

efa3748c92999ed6.en: Old permit on a new board · basis for the conclusion
efa3748c92999ed6.zh: 新告示牌上的旧许可 · 结论依据

fd38eb0a8f626ac8.en: Works by day, disappears at night · basis for the conclusion
